message.description: A top-level or threaded message. The primary content node.

edit.description: Replaces a prior message in the derived current-state view. The replaced node is retained; readers walk edit chains to resolve latest text.

reaction.description: An emoji annotation on a target node. Also the carrier of agent-initiated consent (docs/externally-anchored-lines.md §3): the agent appends a question-shaped message, a seat appends a reaction under it, refusal is the default (no reaction = no node).

tombstone.description: Marks a branch as deleted. Readers skip tombstoned branches when deriving current state.
